svg.aria-label: Five minutes of friction, drawn as a small block. Ten blocks make a day: fifty minutes. Five days make a week: about four hours. Fifty weeks make a year: over two hundred hours, the same as five full working weeks, drawn as five long bars. Then the same stack repeated for every developer on the team.
svg.text: the back-of-envelope: 5 min x 10 a day x 50 weeks
x every developer on your team
